outcome: Timing of developmental milestones (head support, rolling, sitting, standing, walking, talking, toilet training, dressing, feeding)
finding: Vaginally born children achieved developmental milestones earlier than children born by cesarean section, and elective cesarean delivery was associated with greater adiposity in preadolescence compared to vaginal or emergency cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Children born by elective cesarean section had greater adiposity in preadolescence compared to those born vaginally or by emergency cesarean section.
